newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary govt modifies free trade rules - spokesman.
newsitem.headline: Hungary govt modifies free trade rules - spokesman.

text.p: Hungary's government has approved the extension of duty free imports from the Central European Free Trade Agreement (CEFTA), a government official said on Thursday.

"The amendment means that goods imported from CEFTA countries, but originated in other countries, with which the importer has similar free trade agreements would also be duty-free," government spokesman Elemer Kiss told a news conference following the regular cabinet meeting.
